title: Undo with immutable state
description:
Build an editor state with unlimited undo and redo, made cheap by immutable updates.

```
add "a", add "b", toggle 1      -> 3 history entries
undo -> toggle undone; undo -> "b" gone
redo -> "b" back
new action after undo -> redo history cleared
memory: unchanged to-dos are shared between all versions
```
hints: `dispatch` pushes `present` onto `past`, sets the new state and empties `future`; undo moves `present` to the front of `future` (lesson 8.05).
If `reduce` returns the same object, nothing changed: return the history as it was.
requirements: A history object `{ past: [], present, future: [] }` around the to-do reducer from this milestone's practice.
`dispatch(history, action)`, `undo(history)` and `redo(history)` return new history objects.
Actions that change nothing do not add history entries.
stretch: Limit the past to 100 entries and group rapid typing into one undo step.
